findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: Only the client has the right to terminate without cause, with immediate effect, and without paying for the work you have done.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon 30 days' written notice, and Client shall pay Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client upon delivery, before you have received payment for it.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I look forward to working together and have a couple of quick notes before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on termination, the current text permits ending the contract without notice or payment for completed work, so I propose updating it so either party can terminate with 30 days' notice and payment for services performed. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, the current text transfers ownership upon delivery prior to payment, so I propose updating it so rights transfer upon receipt of full payment. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards.
